summary: D1 adds domain_observations keyed (product_id, domain_id) with a foreign key to domains and ON DELETE NO ACTION, reusing the domain attachment-set pattern and carrying the CD-0030 D1 bounds unchanged; D2 caps each Domain at 64 open observations and refuses a full window rather than evicting, because silent eviction is the drop CD-0030 exists to prevent; D3 makes dismissal a two-state flip modeled on work_messages with ApprovalClass required, so the queue is the operator's, while recording stays ApprovalClass none; D4 leaves promotion as the CD-0018 raised_from path, independent of dismissal; D5 preserves CD-0030 non-authority verbatim; D6 folds open observations into concord_domain.detail rather than adding a read operation; D7 puts declared ordering within a Domain out of scope and leaves CD-0041 D8 unrevisited.
title: Domain-anchored observations
